creative_brief.topic: How layered motion graphics are represented in FrameForge
creative_brief.audience: Creators learning a visual production workflow
creative_brief.visual_direction: Use original vector graphics and restrained camera movement.
creative_brief.narration_script: A firewall compares network traffic with configured rules. It permits or blocks traffic according to the rule set.
creative_brief.desired_style: Technical explainer with crisp procedural diagrams and restrained 3D.
research_questions: Which official source defines the firewall's filtering behaviour?
ambiguities_to_resolve: The term firewall may refer to network, host-based or application-layer filtering; name the system being described.
restrictions: Do not present simulated dashboards as real evidence.
Do not use unrelated stock footage.

sources.title: Firewall technical guide
sources.notes: Illustrative source entry for schema validation; replace with a real reviewed source in production.

claims.text: A firewall compares network traffic with a configured rule set.
claims.uncertainty_notes: Specific filtering behaviour depends on the firewall type and configuration.

visual_style_observations: Reference network diagrams are best used to explain topology, not to imply a real captured network.

reference_videos.title: Network explainer format reference
reference_videos.creator: Example Channel
reference_videos.notes: Reference only: study the pacing and diagram structure; do not reuse protected footage or audio.
observed_format: Animated diagram reveals the network path

research_questions: Which official source defines the firewall's filtering behaviour?
confidence_notes: The example's source and video URLs are placeholders used to demonstrate the data structure.

visual_style_profile.label: Cybersecurity technical explainer
visual_style_profile.visual_language: Use labelled network topology, packet-flow diagrams and clearly identified interface simulations.
visual_style_profile.camera_language: Push in to a device, track the packet path and hold on the rule decision.
visual_style_profile.sound_language: Subtle clicks and digital pulses synced to visible interface events; keep narration dominant.
avoid: Simulated screens shown as authentic evidence

shot_plan.director_notes: Sourced factual claim is visually supported by a labelled explanatory diagram. The diagram is not represented as actual network capture.

beats.narration: A firewall compares network traffic with configured rules.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the packet path entering a firewall and the allow/block decision point.
beats.camera_movement: Track along the network path, then hold on the rule decision.
visual_actions: Animate one packet travelling toward the firewall
beats.effect_notes: Use a restrained path highlight and short status pulse; do not add decorative glitch effects.
beats.transition_out: Match cut to the outcome diagram
audio_cues: Quiet interface click when the rule is evaluated
beats.notes: The diagram is an explanatory visual, not footage of a real packet capture.

rights_review.notes: Only original procedural artwork is in the example project.
